documents.text: Lahu Ke Do Rang (1979 film) Lahu Ke Do Rang is a 1979 Hindi movie directed by Mahesh Bhatt. The film stars Vinod Khanna, Helen, Danny Denzongpa, Shabana Azmi, Ranjeet and Prema Narayan. The music and lyrics for the film are by Bappi Lahiri and Farooq Qaiser respectively. The story, screenplay and dialogues of the film are written by Suraj Sanim. The film was shot in Hong Kong and India. The film was rated a "hit" at the Box Office.
